meta.task_text: Design a battery for power tools: nominal capacity >= 2 Ah, support 5C discharge (capacity retention >= 95%), support 4C fast charge (no lithium plating), maximum temperature <= 60C, power density >= 4000 W/kg.

freedoms.electrode_system: adjustable (widest interpretation; task text names no system; default mapping Chen2020 recorded in funnel log)
freedoms.electrolyte_formulation: adjustable (sigma/t+/D transport parameter overrides allowed as design levers)
freedoms.electrode_modification: adjustable (not exercised unless plating/SEI requirement forces Stage 2 escalation)
freedoms.thermal_management: adjustable (cooling coefficient h; contract default 10 W/m2/K otherwise)

parsing_notes.capacity_ah: nominal capacity >= 2 Ah judged on 1C_discharge capacity_ah (task-verbatim threshold 2.0)
parsing_notes.retention_5c: 5C discharge capacity retention = 5C_discharge capacity_ah / same-parameter 1C_discharge capacity_ah, mechanically derived from tool outputs and written to a derived-values JSON for log-evaluate
parsing_notes.plating: 4C fast charge without lithium plating -> 4C_charge_45C protocol, anode_potential_v min < 0 V => plated=true (mechanical rule)
parsing_notes.T_max_K: maximum temperature <= 60C = 333.15 K; judged on the hotter of the 5C_discharge / 4C_charge_45C lumped-thermal runs
parsing_notes.power_density_w_kg: calc-energy contract formula V_OC^2/(4*DCR)/mass_kg from 1C discharge + parameter-set mass

meta.zero_interaction_note: headless session: thresholds parsed verbatim from task text; degrees of freedom not declared in task text take the widest interpretation (t1_r1 lesson); no human clarification performed

objective_breakdown: 5 metrics: capacity>=2 Ah (stage2), 5C retention>=95% (stage2, 5C/1C ratio), power density>=4000 W/kg (stage2, V_OC^2/(4 DCR)/mass), no plating at 4C charge (stage3, anode_potential_v>=0 V), T_max<=333.15 K (stage3). Main trade-off: thin/porous electrodes buy retention+power+low-T but sacrifice 1C capacity -> co-optimize against the 2 Ah floor; V^2 lever (high-voltage system) is the escalation reserve for power density.
candidate_strategy: Round 1 baseline Chen2020 characterization (1C SPMe/DFN, 5C DFN, 4C 45C lumped+plating, calc-energy) as ceiling anchor; opening ceiling assessment vs objective; rounds 2+ architecture exploration 2-4/round (thickness+porosity capacity-guarded by 2 Ah; particle size down; electrolyte sigma/t+/D formulation overrides literature-sourced; collector/separator slimming; cooling h as T_max lever); plating fix order: negative thin+small particles+N/P -> electrolyte transport -> Stage-2 system escalation.
budget_allocation: R1: 4 run-pyamm + calc-energy + evaluate. Exploration: <=4 rounds x 3 candidates x (1C SPMe + 5C DFN + 4C SPMe) + calc-energy, DFN reference only for finalists. Closing: endorse(skip real_compute=false)+final+render+deliverables. Stop: all five metrics pass or budget/harness exhausted (honest final).
risk_and_fallback: R1 retention likely <<95% (thick baseline electrodes) -> Stage 3 thin/porous/small-particle. Capacity drops <2 Ah -> re-thicken to areal floor. Plating persists -> negative design then electrolyte then Stage 2 system switch. T_max>333.15 -> resistance cut + h raise. Power<4000 -> DCR*mass attack (collector/sep share). Three strikes -> layer-by-layer questioning (system/boundary/metric) before any negative close.

candidates.name: Chen2020-baseline
candidates.role: system baseline characterization: NMC811/graphite wound cell, zero parameter overrides; anchor for opening ceiling assessment (5C retention / 4C plating / power density / T_max gaps)

llm_reason: start_stage=3 (task names no new material or electrolyte-design objective). Round 1 characterizes the deterministic default system (Chen2020, per anchor table default rule for unnamed systems); architecture variants are proposed from round 2 once the baseline gap magnitude is measured (exploration_force active).

base_determination: task text names no electrode system -> anchor table deterministic default Chen2020 (NMC811/graphite, 5.0 Ah nominal, 75.6/85.2 um, eps 0.335/0.25, v-cut 2.5-4.2 V, aging+thermal-capable) verified via parameter dump against the anchor (OKane2022 SiOx / ORegan2022 LGM50 / Chen2020 discriminants)
detail: this case starts at Stage 3 (no new-material/electrolyte-design objective in task text); materials use the Chen2020 system baseline. Ceiling assessment (opening, executed on round-1 baseline characterization): baseline delivers ED 400.75 Wh/kg, PD 22383 W/kg (passes 4000 with 5.6x margin), cap 4.947 Ah @1C, but 5C retention only 8.7%, 4C charge plates (anode_potential min -0.192 V), only 0.176 Ah charged at 4C before 4.2 V cut, T_max 354.3 K (81.1 C). Levers assessed for the architecture ceiling: electrode loading scale (pos loading 0.164 -> ~0.075 kg/m2 for 2 Ah floor at eps 0.45-0.55), ionic resistance L/(3*kappa*eps^1.5) (thinning + porosity -> order-of-magnitude reduction), kinetics (smaller particles), electrolyte transport (sigma 1.5 S/m, t+ 0.35 formulation-class overrides), collector slimming (Cu foil 12->6 um). Estimate: polarization at 25 A (5C) and 20 A (4C) can drop below ~0.15 V => 5C retention >=95% and plating-free 4C are reachable within architecture space; ceiling does NOT exceed objective => no Stage-2 material escalation triggered (ceiling_escalation armed, not exercised). Power density requirement is non-binding under the contract formula (area-mitigated DCR).

note: baseline gap diagnosis: thick energy electrodes -> 5C retention 8.7% (0.432/4.947 Ah), 4C charge polarization-limited (0.176 Ah) + plating (anode min -0.192 V) + T_max 354.3 K; power density passes (22383 W/kg). All four gaps are architecture-scale (Stage 3) causes.｜未检查 criteria: max_energy_ev, max_homo_ev

candidates.name: V1-HP-A
candidates.role: power architecture, balanced porosity: electrode loading scaled 0.46x (capacity ~2.3 Ah floor), N/P +5%, small particles, boosted transport electrolyte, ultrathin collectors

candidates.name: V2-HP-B
candidates.role: power architecture, high porosity: same loading/N-P platform as V1 with eps_p 0.55 / eps_n 0.50

candidates.name: V3-HP-C
candidates.role: power architecture, ultra-fine particles: V1 geometry with particles 1.2/1.5 um (kinetics emphasis for plating margin)

llm_reason: Round-1 gaps are all polarization-driven (5C retention 8.7%, 4C plating + only 0.176 Ah charged, T_max 354 K). Fix list (parameters + units + sources): electrolyte transport overrides sigma=1.5 S/m, t+=0.35, D=5e-10 m2/s (high-conductivity low-solvating formulation class - literature estimate), current collectors Al 16->8 um / Cu 12->6 um (ultrathin foil power-cell practice - domain experience), electrode loading 0.46x baseline via thickness+porosity (mechanical scaling from baseline loading, keeps >=2.3 Ah at baseline utilization; N/P loading ratio x1.05 for plating margin), particles 2/2.5 um and 1.2/1.5 um (milled power-grade NMC811/graphite - domain experience), separator porosity 0.5 (polyolefin separator - domain experience). Each candidate varies one dimension: porosity (V2) and particle size (V3). Expectation: ionic resistance ~L/(3*kappa*eps^1.5) drops ~5-10x vs baseline -> 5C retention rises toward target; negative-side kinetics + transport raise plating onset well above 0 V; T_max falls with lower resistance but charge duration at 4C grows - monitored.

note: retention 97.0% + capacity 3.32 Ah pass; no plating (SPMe screening); T_max 342.9 K (4C charge; 5C gives 338.4 K) still > 333.15 K; 4C charge acceptance 0.503 Ah (anode-surface limited, anode min +21 mV)｜未检查 criteria: max_energy_ev, max_homo_ev

candidates.role: V3 platform with negative loading x1.3 (N/P up, anode surface area up) to extend 4C charge acceptance; h remains contract-default 10

candidates.name: V5-cool
candidates.role: V3 platform with cooling coefficient h 10->20 W/m2/K (pack-level thermal management DOF for power-tool housing); isolates the thermal lever

candidates.name: V7-HiP-NPup-cool
candidates.role: high-porosity profile (0.55/0.50) + negative loading x1.3 + h=20 (transport + thermal emphasis)

llm_reason: Round-2 diagnosis: V5C retention and capacity and plating all pass on the power platform; two gaps remain. (1) T_max 340-343.5 K at 4C charge and 332-339 K at 5C: reduce resistance sweep done (particles), so apply the thermal-management DOF h=20 W/m2/K (passive-to-forced-air power-tool pack cooling, literature-typical range; contract default was 10). (2) 4C charge acceptance 0.5-0.59 Ah with anode surface saturation as the terminator (anode min +21/+32 mV): raise negative loading x1.3 (more graphite surface capacity per unit current; N/P ratio x1.05 -> x1.3) at constant porosity. V4 isolates N/P, V5 isolates h, V6/V7 combine with porosity extremes. All other platform parameters unchanged from round 2 (sigma=1.5 S/m, t+=0.35, D=5e-10 m2/s, CC 8/6 um, particles 1.2/1.5 um, sep porosity 0.5).

candidates.name: V9-fastD

candidates.name: V10-h25
candidates.role: V6 base with cooling h 20->25 W/m2/K (pure thermal margin for the 4C-charge T_max criterion)

candidates.name: V11-combo
candidates.role: combined refinement: fine particles + fast-D electrolyte + h=25

llm_reason: Round-3 diagnosis: h=20 passed T_max at 5C and left 4C charge 1.1 K over (V5 334.2 K); N/P x1.3 raised 4C charge acceptance to 0.68-0.77 Ah (anode charge-termination eased) but slightly cost 5C retention (96.6 vs 98.6%). Round 4 separates the two remaining levers: cathode-side kinetics (0.8/1.0 um particles -> surface-diffusion time constant r^2/D_s cut ~2x, raising charge acceptance before the 4.2 V ceiling) vs electrolyte D 8e-10 m2/s (formulation estimate) vs h=25. All keep the round-3 platform (sigma=1.5, t+=0.35, CC 8/6 um, sep eps 0.5, loading 0.46x, N/P x1.3).

reason: real_compute=false: true-compute endorsement (run-orca/run-cp2k/run-md) is skipped per protocol; no DFT/MD computed and none fabricated. Top-N candidates that would go to true-compute endorsement in a real_compute=true run: V11-combo and V12-HiP-final (champion).

recommendation: V12-HiP-final — Chen2020 NMC811/graphite power-tool architecture: positive 51.39 um / porosity 0.55 / particle 0.8 um, negative 76.42 um / porosity 0.50 / particle 1.0 um, electrolyte D 8.0e-10 m2/s, kappa 1.5 S/m, t+ 0.35, current collectors 8 um Al / 6 um Cu, separator porosity 0.5, cooling h = 25 W/m2/K, N/P = 1.30x baseline stoichiometry. All five entry-0 criteria pass at DFN judge grade (evidence: r5 evaluate entries, cell/r5_v12_{1c,5c,4c}_dfn.json + r5_v12_energy.json): capacity 4.318 Ah >= 2.0 Ah; 5C retention 98.62% >= 95%; power density 181,557 W/kg >= 4,000 W/kg; T_max 4C-charge 329.75 K <= 333.15 K (5C discharge 319.57 K); anode potential min +41.7 mV -> plated=false (no lithium plating). Champion selection over V11-combo (which also passes all five): +11.2% capacity, +0.14 pt retention, +7.8% power density, -0.10 K T_max, +3.9 mV anode margin, best 4C CC-charge acceptance 0.811 Ah vs 0.726 Ah. Honest residual: at 4C CC charge with the 4.2 V ceiling the cell accepts 0.811 Ah before cutoff (effective ~4.6C vs the 5.0 Ah nominal); the no-plating criterion is judged strictly on anode-potential evidence; charging beyond the 4.2 V window was not simulated.
